## Per-criterion drills

- redundancy: run the maintained fixture above, including "measures exact units and keeps unresolved populations separate" and "registered instruments recompute exact-window raw populations with explicit ledger units". The seeded 10 duplicate added lines / 200 eligible added lines yields 50 per 1,000 lines. Its ledger quantity uses count; retain the per-1,000 interpretation. Missing raw census stays unknown.
- search-before-write: the same fixture requires an exact unique work-item assignment and recorded successful search before first write. The seeded eligible item yields 100 percent. Preserve eligible/observed/unknown partitions; issuance alone is not search.
- cross-file-calls: the same fixture supplies one resolved cross-file call and yields 100 percent. Keep unresolved call identities separate from the resolved denominator; static calls are not runtime executions.
- provider-outcomes: run the fixture's hash cohort, twenty-invocation/thirty-minute window, duplicate-identity, malformed-activity, mature-disable, mature-keep and immature/unknown refusal cases. Issued does not prove delivered; no independent client receipt remains unknown. Only complete, mature controlled evidence can disable a provider through the maintained flag writer. Retain the evidence reference and exact reversal flag; re-enable with the recorded flag writer when reversing that decision.
